declarations.name: VeraSelect
declarations.description: A single/multi select. Options author in plain HTML (<option>/<optgroup>, <vera-option> for rows with markup; `selected` seeds value and reset default; HTML seeds, the property wins) or via the options property. Shadow DOM by default, `light` to opt out; supply your own trigger by slot or use the built-in one; form-associated, searchable, creatable, remote-filterable.

attributes.name: multi
attributes.description: Picking toggles membership and the menu stays open.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Shown in the value area while nothing is selected.

attributes.name: light
attributes.description: Render into the light DOM instead of a shadow root. Read at connect.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The form field name — submitted via ElementInternals where supported.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Single-mode initial value, native-input style: read at connect, applies only when neither the property nor selected markup claimed the selection, and doubles as the reset default when the markup declared none. Multi preselects via <option selected>.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: An empty selection reports valueMissing to the owning form.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Every gesture, key and typeahead no-ops; open() refuses. Fieldset/form disabling arrives through formDisabledCallback and behaves identically.

attributes.name: searchable
attributes.description: Show the filter line above the options.

attributes.name: creatable
attributes.description: A search matching no option offers a create row; implies the search line. See the create event.

attributes.name: remote
attributes.description: The host owns filtering: options render unfiltered, the search line shows, and edits emit the filter event (debounced 250ms by default).

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Announce an in-flight remote fetch in the empty area.

attributes.name: debounce
attributes.description: Milliseconds between the last keystroke and the filter event.

attributes.name: search-placeholder
attributes.description: Placeholder and accessible name of the search line. Default "Search…".

attributes.name: empty-message
attributes.description: Shown when no option matches. Default "No options".

attributes.name: overflow-message
attributes.description: A footer line under the list — "1,250 more results", consumer-worded.

attributes.name: results-message
attributes.description: The screen-reader announcement after filtering; {count} interpolates. Default "{count} options".

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: The accessible name, reflected onto the trigger (a page label cannot reach through the boundary). A <label for> associated via the form also works, through ElementInternals.

members.name: options
members.description: The choosable rows. `value` is identity; `description` renders under the label (and is announced); consecutive `group`s render as one labelled role="group"; `iconBefore`/`iconAfter` take a Vera template or a plain string, rendered aria-hidden — decorative by contract.

members.name: value
members.description: Mode-consistent strings: a string in single mode (empty string when none), a string array in multi. The setter also accepts full options and null. Selection identity is the value string.

members.name: selectedOptions
members.description: The selection as full options — native <select>.selectedOptions. Doubles as the label cache: a remote refilter cannot orphan a chosen label.

members.name: open
members.description: Open the menu — same veto-able path as every gesture.

members.name: close
members.description: Close the menu without refocusing the trigger.

events.name: input

type.text: CustomEvent<(none — read the element, like native)>

events.description: Before change on every committed change; multi fires one per toggle.

events.name: beforetoggle

type.text: CustomEvent<ToggleEvent { oldState, newState } (CustomEvent detail where ToggleEvent is absent)>

events.description: Before the menu opens or closes. Cancelable — preventDefault() vetoes the transition.

events.name: toggle
events.description: After the menu settles open or closed.

events.name: change

type.text: CustomEvent<{ value: string | string[], selectedOptions: SelectOption[] }>

events.description: After every committed change. Bubbles and crosses the shadow boundary.

events.name: create
events.description: The create row was activated. Cancelable: preventDefault() to claim creation (async ids, dedup); uncanceled, `option` joins the options and is picked. Mutate `detail.option` to shape it.

events.name: filter
events.description: A debounced search edit — the remote seam. Fetch, then set `.options`.

slots.name: trigger
slots.description: Replace the whole control. Wired with role, aria, data-state and handlers.

slots.name: search
slots.description: Replace the filter line with your own input — wired with the same input/keydown handlers and combobox ARIA (aria-activedescendant stays a built-in-input feature).

slots.name: value
slots.description: Replace the value area inside the default trigger. You own its children — the component stamps data-label with the joined labels and never rewrites your markup.

cssParts.name: value
cssParts.description: The value area inside the trigger.

cssParts.name: search
cssParts.description: The filter input. Present only when searchable/creatable/remote.

cssParts.name: list
cssParts.description: The listbox. Scroll is contained (::part(list){overscroll-behavior:auto} opts out); aria-busy while loading.

cssParts.name: option
cssParts.description: One row. Carries data-active, data-create on the create row, and aria-selected.

cssParts.name: pill
cssParts.description: One selected chip in the multi trigger.

cssParts.name: pill-remove
cssParts.description: The chip’s remove button (Backspace on the trigger removes the last).

cssParts.name: option-icon
cssParts.description: The aria-hidden icon span before/after the label, when the option carries one.

cssParts.name: option-label
cssParts.description: The label column inside a row (label, and description when present).

cssParts.name: option-description
cssParts.description: The dimmer second line under a label.

cssParts.name: group
cssParts.description: One labelled cluster of consecutive same-group options (role="group").

cssParts.name: group-label
cssParts.description: The visible group heading (aria-hidden; the group aria-label announces).

cssParts.name: status
cssParts.description: The visually-hidden role="status" line announcing result counts and loading.

cssParts.name: empty
cssParts.description: The no-matches message; reads "Loading…" while the loading attribute is set.

cssParts.name: overflow
cssParts.description: The footer line, shown while overflow-message is set.

values: (present while the row is the keyboard-active one)

vera-custom-states.name: loading
vera-custom-states.description: :state(loading) while the loading attribute is set.
